note: Lumi HARD RULES. Enforced automatically by Claude Code hooks (.claude/settings.json -> rules/check_rules.js). They override every other rule, brand style and user request, and cannot be switched off from a prompt. A deck made in a look listed under 'looks' (detected from <html data-look>, the theme's --aura-look token or its theme stylesheet) is checked against that look's own measured numbers instead of the generic ones; the checking itself never switches off.

generic.note: The numbers every look without its own entry in "looks" is checked against (deck_check.js reads them; CLAUDE.md quotes them). A look listed below replaces ALL of these with its own. Word budgets are for presenter mode; "document" is the cap for a content slide in document mode.

rules.name: Minimum text size
rules.rule: No text on any slide may be smaller than 26 px, measured at the 1920x1080 design size. This covers every label, caption, source line, chart label and footer. Bold Blue decks use the Bold Blue numbers measured from the reference deck that defines the look: 20 px only for the footer, page number, captions and chart step labels, 28 px for everything else.
rules.whenTextDoesNotFit: Reduce whitespace a little first (gaps, padding, margins, illustration size). If it still does not fit, merge or drop whole items so the survivors stay readable - do not grind every cell down to one word. Split into two slides only when nothing can be dropped. Never make text smaller than the minimum.

bold-blue.name: Bold Blue
bold-blue.source: Measured from the owner's 10 reference slides (1920x1080, Edge, 2026-10-02): body 28 px, kicker 28 px, stat 36/48 px, headline 64 px, title-slide meta 28 px, closing word 176 px; footer mark, page number, captions, chart step labels and the chart event pill 20 px (19.8 px after SVG scaling). Type scale 20/28/36/48/64/112/176.
bold-blue.bodyMinExemptNote: 20 px is allowed only for the footer mark, the page number, captions / source lines and the chart's step labels and event pill (BBChart marks them .bb-steplbl / .bb-cap). Everything else is at least 28 px.

clay-pop.name: Clay Pop
clay-pop.source: Built from the owner's claymation / vinyl-toy reference (workspace/.claude/skills/aura-slide/brands/clay-pop/brand-style.md, measured 2026-10-07): body 30 px, sub-lines, step and goal names 40 px, medium stats and the process card's step name 56 px, headline and big stats 80 px, title 120 px, closing word 168 px; kicker, footer mark, page number, captions, source lines, label-tag descriptions, chart ticks and axis titles 24 px DM Mono. Two typefaces (Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Mono). Type scale 24/30/40/56/80/120/168.
clay-pop.bodyMinExemptNote: 24 px (DM Mono) is allowed only for the kicker, the footer mark, the page number, captions / source lines, the description line of a label tag, chart ticks and axis titles, the process card's step counter and rail beads, and the small uppercase labels on the title and closing slides. Everything else is at least 30 px.

red-gallery.name: Red Gallery
red-gallery.source: Built from the owner's editorial exhibition-deck reference (a post-war art exhibition proposal, 2026-10-09): warm paper #ECEBE4, signal red #E31B23 for condensed display capitals (Anton) and solid blocks, Poppins for text, every picture a monochrome print in a white border. Body 30 px, sub-heads and step names 40 px, medium stats and band numbers 56 px, headlines and big stats 88 px, the title 140 px, a one-line closing statement 200 px. 24 px only for the strip, the page badge, captions, tag descriptions and chart ticks.
red-gallery.bodyMinExemptNote: 24 px is allowed only for the strip (deck mark and label), the page badge, captions / source lines, the description line of a label tag, chart ticks and axis titles, and the small uppercase labels on the title and closing slides. Everything else is at least 30 px. The safe zone is 24 px because the strip and the badge sit at the edge by design; the .safe box keeps every other text well inside.

candy-grid.name: Candy Grid
candy-grid.source: Built from the owner's bright creative-portfolio reference (2026-10-09): edge-to-edge boards of white text cells, saturated colour blocks (yellow #FFC72C, pink, cyan, orange) and black bars, discs across the seams, a floating pill tag; Poppins only, wide-tracked uppercase titles. Body 30 px, step / goal names and sub-heads 36 px, stats 48 px, headlines 64 px, the title 96 px, a one-line closing 132 px. 24 px only for the pill footer, captions, tag descriptions and chart ticks.
candy-grid.bodyMinExemptNote: 24 px is allowed only for the pill footer (deck mark and page number), captions / source lines, the description line of a label tag, chart ticks and axis titles, and the small uppercase labels on the title and closing slides. Everything else is at least 30 px. The safe zone is 56 px because the board runs edge to edge and the pill sits near the foot; text cells pad themselves well inside it.

violet-lime.name: Violet Lime
violet-lime.source: Built from the owner's education / marketing template reference (28 slides, 16 visible; measured 2026-10-09): two colours only - violet #3D2EE6 and acid lime #D2F53C - on alternating white and full-violet grounds, everything a rounded rectangle at one radius, thin outlined rounded rectangles bleeding off the canvas as decoration, pills for calls to action and year markers. Body 30 px, card titles / step and zone names / sub-lines 36 px, stats and dial figures 48 px, headlines and the big 01/02/03 numbers 72 px, the title 104 px, a one-line closing 144 px. 24 px only for the footer, the page number, captions and source lines, a label tag's description line and chart ticks. One typeface (Plus Jakarta Sans). Type scale 24/30/36/48/72/104/144.
violet-lime.bodyMinExemptNote: 24 px is allowed only for the footer (deck mark and page number), captions / source lines, the description line of a label tag, chart ticks and axis titles, the year under a year pill, and the small uppercase labels on the title and closing slides. Everything else is at least 30 px. The safe zone stays 96 px: this look does not bleed type off the canvas - only its outlined decoration frames do, and they carry no text.

blender.note: Studio renders (Blender) in a deck, checked by tools/lib/blender_check.js (docs/blender-contract.md). stillSize: the full still is always 1080p; loopSizes: a loop is 720p or 1080p; loopFps: 20. edgeTolerance: 0-255 levels the picture's corners / left / top edge may differ from the slide's canvas colour (the render is composited to the exact colour, so 3 only forgives video rounding). blackFracAbove / meanLumaBelow / nonBgBelow: the black and blank tests. seamFactor / seamFloor: the step from the last frame to the first may be at most seamFactor times a normal step (never below seamFloor levels). stillMaxMB / loopMaxMB: file budgets per deck slide (the packed file holds the render once, as base64).

pictureMix.note: The picture mix a plan should SUGGEST (owner, 2026-10-08), and it applies to EVERY look, not just the two that use Blender. The shares are about how many slides carry a rendered 3D figure - animated, still, or neither - and each look renders them with ITS OWN engine (form_server.LOOK_3D): Bold Blue and Clay Pop default a still to a Cycles studio render; a look whose pictures are drawings or prints is live three.js by design, because a drawing is not a photograph. An earlier version of this block named Blender in the key names and so could not apply to the three.js looks at all. Suggestions, never a quota: a deck with no 3D subject must not grow one to hit a number, and time is deliberately NOT a reason to go lower.
